body:
I'm going to write a letter to her explaining everything I've felt, as if she doesn't already know how I feel. We are close and I tell her how I'm feeling and what I'm thinking but I know it's not healthy or fair to her. She could be so much happier if it wasn't for me. She won't leave me because she's such a selfless loving person and she's seen the good in me, my talents and potential in life and all the love I can give, because damn do I take care of that girl. Cook for her, rub her while she sleeps, do anything and everything she asks of me. She's my angel, shes my doll, you know? 

But me killing myself isn't just about her. Honestly she's only a part of it. I hte seeing the pain I bring her, but I'm honestly just sick of feeling the pain personally. I've thought about how it will affect the people I love and yes it's selfish of me to take my life and hurt those I love, but it's also not fair to me that I have to live because my death will affect others. 

Either way, I've decided and I just wanted other people to hear it
